newsitem.title: USA: ARIS buys Noetix Corp for undisclosed terms.
newsitem.headline: ARIS buys Noetix Corp for undisclosed terms.

text.p: ARIS Corp's ARIS Software Inc said it bought Noetix Corp, a rapidly-growing software company which develops products allowing non-technical users easy access to data stored in Oracle Applications systems.
The terms of the purchase were not disclosed.

Noetix Corp's key product, NoetixViews(TM), takes the information in complex Oracle Applications data tables and automatically converts it into a layer of user-friendly information for use with database query/reporting tools.
